arStrings.szText: {c_important}Charged Bolts{/c} releases {c_number}{SF_9}{/c} additional bolt, plus {c_number}{SF_9}{/c} additional bolt per stack of {u}{c_important}Ferocity{/c}{/u}.

Casting {u}{c_important}Charged Bolts{/c}{/u} now also discharges {u}{c_important}Crackling Energy{/c}{/u} in an electric wave, dealing its damage to all enemies caught in it.

{u}{c_important}Crackling Energy{/c}{/u} will no longer automatically pulse its last {c_number}{SF_10}{/c} charges.

{c_important}Charged Bolts{/c} becomes a {c_important}Pyromancy{/c} Skill, deals Fire damage, and costs {c_number}{SF_15}{/c} Mana.

Each bolt no longer pierces and instead releases {c_number}2{/c} to {c_number}3{/c} explosions on impact, dealing an additional {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEC_SPARK_DAMAGE}{/c} damage.

{c_important}Charged Bolts{/c} deals {c_number}[SF_21 * 100 |%x|]{/c} increased damage to Close enemies.

{c_important}Charged Bolts{/c} releases {c_number}{SF_29}{/c} additional bolt.

{c_important}Charged Bolts{/c} {u}{c_important}Weakens{/c}{/u} enemies for {c_number}{SF_22}{/c} seconds.

{c_important}Charged Bolts{/c} releases {c_number}{SF_29}{/c} additional bolt.

Each time you cast {c_important}Charged Bolts{/c} it gains {c_number}[SF_23 * 100 |%+|]{/c} Cast Speed, up to {c_number}[SF_23 * 100 * SF_30 |%+|]{/c}. Moving removes this effect.

{c_important}Charged Bolts{/c} releases {c_number}{SF_29}{/c} additional bolt.

Each time you cast {c_important}Charged Bolts{/c} it gains {c_number}[SF_24 * 100|%x|]{/c} bolt speed and you gain {c_number}[SF_24 * 100|%s|]{/c} Movement Speed for {c_number}{buffDuration:UPGRADE4_SPEED}{/c} seconds, up to {c_number}[SF_24 * 100 * SF_26|%x|]{/c}.

{c_important}Charged Bolts{/c} releases {c_number}{SF_29}{/c} additional bolt.
